verdict.rationale: The RTX PRO 6000 is hardware, but it ships with a developer software ecosystem (CUDA Toolkit, CUDA-X libraries), so an interactive API reference is a fair question. The evidence describes libraries and an llms.txt index but shows no interactive, runnable API reference, and every OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404. The free inference endpoints on build.nvidia.com and Brev launchables are adjacent features of separate NVIDIA services, not an API reference for this product, so they earn no credit.
